item.title: Senate passes massive government funding package, sending it to House
item.description: The Senate voted overwhelmingly Friday to pass a major funding package consisting of five regular appropriations bills and a two-week stopgap measure for the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) but the legislation won’t become law before parts of the government shut down at midnight. item.title: 300 endangered sea turtles released into Gulf as large crowd cheers them on
item.description: Iowa resident Laurie Nielson watched in awe Thursday as 300 sea turtles were released into the Gulf from South Padre Island.

item.title: Woman helps unhoused community in Rutherford Co. ahead of snowstorm
item.description: With freezing temperatures and a snowstorm inbound, one woman is working to keep the unhoused community in Rutherford County warm.

item.title: Seneca man dies after slipping on ice following storm
item.description: SENECA, S.C. (WSPA) - The Oconee County Coroner's Office said a man died Wednesday evening after slipping on an ice patch outside of his home. item.title: Dozens more measles cases reported in Upstate outbreak, hundreds still in quarantine
item.description: State health officials reported 58 new measles cases in the Upstate Friday. This brings the total number of cases related to the current outbreak to 847.

item.title: Teens charged months after deadly shooting at Spartanburg Co. apartments
item.description: Two suspects have been charged in connection to a shooting that killed a 16-year-old at an apartment complex in Spartanburg County.

item.title: 'A pretty hectic week': Spartanburg Co. crews prepare for second winter storm
item.description: Spartanburg County emergency crews are once again preparing for winter weather, marking the second system to impact the area in less than two weeks.
